name: Volume Raycasting with Front/Back Face Depth Textures
aliases: Ray Casting with Pre-computed Entry/Exit Textures
Volume Ray Casting with Pre-computed Entry/Exit Textures
definition: A volume rendering technique that uses a 3D texture for volume data and two 2D textures storing the depth (Z-coordinate) of the front and back faces of the volume's bounding box for each screen pixel. The raycast shader samples the 3D texture along the ray segment defined by these depths.
summary: This technique renders volumes by using pre-computed front and back face coordinate textures to define ray entry and exit points, avoiding per-ray intersection tests.
